title: Gräddvåfflor (Cream Waffles)
description: Prepared with sour cream, water, and flour.
steps: Whip the cream to stiff peaks, and sift down the flour.

title: Grönkål (Green Cabbage Soup)
description: A soup made with cabbage, meat, and white pepper.

title: Grönsakspastejer (Vegetable Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with carrots, peas, and potato.

ingredients.name: For the potato purée: 750 gr. peeled potato, about 1 1/4 liters unpeeled
1 tsp. salt, 1 tsp. sugar (a little grated nutmeg)

steps: Rinse the carrots well, place in cold salted water and let cook almost soft, then the skin is immediately removed and the carrots are cut into fine strips.
Brush small pastry molds well with cold butter, line the bottom of the molds thickly with peas and garnish the sides thickly, on the slant, with carrot strips.
Treat the potato as described on page 337 et seq., peel thinly, cut into pieces and cook quickly.
Drain the water well and let the potato stand about 5 minutes with the lid ajar so the steam escapes.
Pass the potato through a purée press or stir with a fork into a purée.
Add the cold butter at once and work the purée with a fork until it becomes white and fluffy, then add the cooked cream together with the beaten egg yolks.
Last, cut in the egg white beaten to stiff peaks and taste the purée carefully with the spices.
Fill the molds halfway with the purée, place a layer of peas on top, then fill the molds with purée.
Cook the pastries at once in a water bath in the oven about 15 minutes, turn out and serve as a garnish around fried meat.

title: Gås, stekt i ugn (Roast Goose in Oven)
description: Prepared with goose, white pepper, and apples.
steps: Regarding purchase of goose, see page 299. Singe the goose over a spirit or gas flame, then carefully pluck all feathers and wash the goose well with lukewarm water and a soft brush, then dry it.
The head with neck, wings and feet are cut off and used together with heart, liver and gizzard for black soup (see recipe 255).

Cut open and remove the organs from the goose (see page 300) — remove the fat and place it in cold water along with the fat that is picked from the intestines — rinse well in cold water, dry and rub inside and out with the seasonings.
Fill the bird with the apples, peeled and cut into large wedges, and with the blanched and pitted prunes, sew it closed, truss it (see page 300) and place in a roasting pan.

Place in a warm oven and baste frequently with the fat that forms in the pan; when beautifully browned, pour in the boiling broth and let the goose roast until tender, basting every 10 minutes. Allow 2 1/2 to 3 hours for roasting.
If crispy skin is desired, baste the goose only the first hour, then let it roast with the oven door slightly ajar.
Half an hour before it is done, strain off the gravy and return the goose to the oven with 1/2 liter of boiling water in the pan.
Skim the gravy well, reduce it, season with meat extract and soy sauce and thicken with browned thickening (see page 210).
Place the goose on a platter, remove the trussing strings, cut it and arrange it again so that it appears whole, garnish with browned potatoes, kale or parsley and the fruit with which it was filled.
Serve with red cabbage and pickled cucumber.

title: Halstrad Gädda (Grilled Pike)
description: Prepared with pike, vinegar, and clarified butter.
steps: Clean the pike, rinse well and dry.
Cut into fillets and loosen the flesh from the skin.
Remove the backbone and all small bones.
Rub the fillets with salt and vinegar and let sit for 1/2 hour, then dry well and cut each fillet into 2 pieces crosswise.

description: Prepared with butter, chickens, and white pepper.

ingredients.name: 2 large chickens, about 450 gr. scraped meat

steps: Pluck the chickens, clean them, rinse very well, dry with a cloth and skin them.
Cut all the meat loose from the carcasses and scrape it completely free from sinews and membranes.
Grind the meat 6 times through a meat grinder and pound it together with the spices using a wooden pestle in a stone mortar until the forcemeat becomes fine and smooth.
Remove it and pound the panade (see no. 626) with the butter to form an even dough, add the forcemeat and pound the mixture very well.

title: Inlagda stora gurkor (Pickled Large Cucumbers)
description: Prepared with cucumbers, vinegar, and white pepper.
steps: Prepare the cucumbers as in the preceding recipe, place them in a dish, sprinkle with salt, and let them lie for 24 hours.

Take out the cucumbers, wrap them in a cloth (discard the vinegar), and lay them in alternating layers with the white pepper, pepperroot, and dill crowns in a jar.
Boil the rest of the vinegar with the sugar and pour it hot over the cucumbers, which are covered with double linen and allowed to cool.
Bind the jar well. These cucumbers are strong but excellent.
